study_identification_part.si_4_title: Age-atypical brain functional networks in autism spectrum disorder: a normative modeling approach

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used local polynomial regression fitting (LOESS) to construct age-related normative models of functional connectivity. The local width or smoothing kernel of the regression was determined using hyperparameter optimization across 5-100% of the full age range using Brent's method as implemented in the R optim function from the stats package.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We used a method called the local polynomial regression fitting process (LOESS) to determine the local width or smoothing kernel of the regression model based on the minimum squared error model provided across the entire age range
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Methods and materials / Constructing age-related normative models

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study modeled within-network and between-network functional connectivity (FC) derived from resting-state fMRI. FC matrices (160 x 160) were constructed using the Dosenbach160 atlas, and then aggregated into 6 networks (DMN, FPN, CON, SMN, OCN, CEN) to calculate 23 W-scores representing within- and between-network FC deviations from the normative model.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: we analyzed individuals with ASD and typically developed (TD) controls (total n = 1218) aged 5-40 years, generating individualized whole-brain network functional connectivity (FC) maps of age-related atypicality in ASD

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age was the sole explanatory variable used in the LOESS normative modeling. The model predicted FC values from age to obtain age-specific normative means and standard deviations. Site effects were removed prior to modeling using ComBat harmonization rather than being included as a covariate in the normative model itself.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: This enables prediction of the FC value (the darker blue contour line) from the clinical covariates (age) along with measures of predictive confidence
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Jiang2024.pdf.md: Figure 3 caption / Methods and materials
